title: Mathematics, Standard Ten — Grade 10 Mathematics (Tamil Nadu State Board)

source.title: Mathematics, Standard Ten
source.edition: First Edition 2019; Revised Editions 2020 and 2021; reprinted annually (latest circulating copy labelled 2025 edition)
source.publisher: Tamil Nadu Textbook and Educational Services Corporation (content: SCERT Tamil Nadu)
source.licence: Chapter and section titles as printed (facts); outcomes written by OpenPath in its own words; no textbook text is reproduced.

review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/tn-g10.json. Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://cdn1.byjus.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/TN-Board-SSLC-Class-10-Mathematics-Textbook.pdf https://cdn1.byjus.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Tamil-Nadu-State-Board-Textbooks_Samacheer-Kalvi-Books_Class-10_Maths-English-Medium-Chapter-4.pdf https://www.brainkart.com/subject/Maths-10th-Std_397/ https://www.shaalaa.com/syllabus/tamil-nadu-board-of-secondary-education-class-10-mathematics_8934. Notes: Official sites could not be read: textbooksonline.tn.nic.in (robots disallowed for the fetch tool), tnschools.gov.in/scert (JavaScript-rendered), the official cloudfront e-book HTML/PDF links (fetch errors), textbookcorp.tn.gov.in price list (robots disallowed), dge.tn.gov.in (no syllabus/blueprint notices visible). The chapter and section list comes from a copy of the official TNTBESC/SCERT PDF (Revised Edition 2021 front matter) hosted on cdn1.byjus.com. Chapters are marked verified:true on that basis. Single volume confirmed from the front matter: no term split. Edition for 2026-27: News (DT Next, Sep 2026) says the new SEP-based syllabus applies only to classes 1-3 in 2026-27, so Std 10 should continue with the 2019 book (revised 2020/2021, annual reprints). A file labelled '2025 Edition' circulates but could not be opened, so later minor revisions after 2021 cannot be ruled out. Std 10 is not listed among the 2026-27 'new' books on third-party sites.

outcomes.text: Form ordered pairs and Cartesian products of two or three sets and find the number of elements in a product.

mapping.why: Mapped by the curriculum inventory (marked automatically; set, numeric).

outcomes.text: Decide whether a relation is a function using arrow diagrams, ordered pairs, tables, rules and the vertical line test, and represent functions in these forms.

mapping.why: Mapped by the curriculum inventory (marked automatically; true-false, multiple-choice, set).

outcomes.text: Identify relations as subsets of a Cartesian product and state their domain, co-domain and range.

mapping.why: Mapped by the curriculum inventory (marked automatically; set, multiple-choice).

outcomes.text: Classify functions as one-one, many-one, onto, into or bijective, and recognise constant, identity and real-valued functions.

mapping.why: Mapped by the curriculum inventory (partly marked by an educator; multiple-choice, written-explanation).

outcomes.text: Form and evaluate compositions of functions and check whether composition is commutative or associative for given functions.
